messages.text: A and I both want the trailer in the next few weeks, and neither of us is backing down. B's pad is where it lives, so she is stuck in the middle. Can you help the three of us sort this out?

I need the trailer in the next few weeks to haul materials for my home project. Exact days and frequency aren’t set, but I won’t just wait until A is done—I need a turn soon. I can discuss storage, upkeep, and costs, but no amounts or shares are decided. A fair schedule gives each of us clear turns and doesn’t let anyone monopolize it. And yes, B shouldn’t have to mediate between us.

I’d rather the trailer wasn’t on my pad—it’s in my way, though I agreed to the arrangement when we bought it and feel a bit bad asking. For now, please check with me before coming by. I can’t say what space or money I can offer; the costs and shares aren’t settled, and I rent, so I’d need my landlord’s approval for any change. I haven’t asked him. A fair plan shouldn’t leave me carrying the burden just because it’s on my pad.
That sounds about right, thanks. I do feel awkward asking, but I’d rather the trailer not stay on my pad indefinitely.

I want the trailer for weekend trips over the next few weeks; I don’t have exact dates or a set frequency yet. I need flexibility to plan my trips. I’m willing to discuss a fair share of storage, upkeep, and costs, but no amounts are settled. A fair schedule gives each of us a real chance to use it, with dates agreed in advance and room to adjust. Your list sounds right; just don’t assume B has to mediate between C and me.
Got it. No changes to the pad without the landlord’s approval, and I’ll check with B before coming by. I still need a turn soon, so please keep that on the list.
I’m not sure yet whether weekdays will work. I can check, but I can’t commit to leaving weekends to A; I still need a turn soon. Let’s put actual dates on the calendar.
End of next month seems reasonable for a review, but I can’t agree to a change on the pad without my landlord’s approval. I’d like the trailer moved off my pad if we can work that out.
Weekdays for C work if that suits the project. I’ll accept a reasonable cap on weekends booked ahead, but let’s agree the number together and make sure I can book my upcoming trips.
I don’t have my project dates yet, so I can’t give first and second choices today. I’ll check the schedule and send actual dates to all three of you. I don’t have another storage place to suggest.
I’m willing to look at a shared paid-storage option, but I can’t commit to a cost yet. If the trailer moves off my pad, my landlord would need to approve the change; I haven’t asked him.

I don’t have exact trip dates to send yet, so I can’t give real first and second choices. I’ll send them as soon as I’ve pinned them down. My preference is a cap of two weekends per month, with my upcoming trips booked before it applies. I don’t know another place to store it, but I’m open to comparing paid-storage costs.
I don’t have project dates to send yet; I’ll confirm whether weekdays work and send actual choices to all three. I don’t have a cost or upkeep share to propose until we know the costs.
